| OI-357 | ★ **The Baroque partial-signature correction lives in the LEGACY key resolver, which the production arm does not run — and whether the joint estimator handles that notation practice AT ALL is unestablished in both directions** | Found 2026-08-09 (CC, `cc_instruction_return_continuation_3.md` Task 1) while performing the citation-transfer half of the [[OI-354]] establishment on **D-575**, under the user's Ruling 18. **Read at the record and at the code, not recalled.** Baroque scores are frequently notated with one accidental fewer than the modern practice, so the sounding key sits one step to the sharp side of anything a signature-faithful reading could name; the adopted handling DETECTS that situation — the flattened sixth degree pervasive across the sounding weight and dominating its natural form — and reinterprets the written signature one step for the whole resolution. **That machinery is in `src/composing/analysis/key/keyresolver.{h,cpp}` and the legacy types beside it, and nowhere else**: the joint module carries no construct of that name, its only matches on the search terms being a phrase-split remark and a partial-record remark, both read and neither related. The production arm does not reach the legacy resolver — the record arm's section derivation calls neither `resolveKeyAndModeRanked` nor the legacy key layer, and `--joint-inference` decodes through the joint module alone. **D-575's own home text says the question is open, in terms:** *"Whether the joint estimator handles the convention AT ALL is NOT settled by this entry and is not asserted here."* **★ WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT CLAIMED, because the distinction is the whole row:** absence of the machinery is NOT absence of the handling. The live arm takes the signature and declared mode as a **weak fitted soft prior** with no conditional gate anywhere (**D-528**) rather than as a hard constraint, so a key one step to the sharp side is reachable there without any explicit correction. **This row asserts no defect and no regression** — it asserts that the question is unestablished, which is the state #19 refuses to treat as established. **★ AND ONE THING SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCES ITS SIZE, STATED SO IT IS NOT READ AS LARGER THAN IT IS:** the production arm's key agreement on exactly this repertoire IS measured and published in `CLAUDE.md` gate block (A), so this is not an unmeasured failure behind a green gate — any effect already sits inside a published value. What is missing is whether a named, corpus-wide notation practice is handled on the arm that ships, which bears on how that value should be read. **NOT in doubt:** D-575 itself, its ⚠ LEGACY mark, its superseded-in-fact status and its home, none of which this row reopens; the legacy fix, which landed and was verified on its anchor case; and every published measurement, none of which moves | B — the analysis (what the production key arm does with a Baroque notation practice the legacy arm detected and corrected) | OPEN — rowed 2026-08-09 (CC), and **rowed is all that is done to it**: what is owed FIRST is a read-only establishment — does the production arm read these scores correctly, and by what means — and no fix, design or inference change is authorized by this row (**D-231**; #8's three-clause gate stands). **GATES** — its subject bears on the analysis, which is the test `CLAUDE.md`'s non-gating declaration states, answered YES, so the apparatus declaration does not reach it; and it is independently an establishment obligation (#19), which always gates whatever its subject. **Why it is rowed rather than left in D-575's home text:** the record states the gap only as a scope disclaimer inside one entry's home, and tracking an owed item in prose alone is the #10 violation this register exists against — the [[OI-283]] shape. **★ THE EARLY, BOUNDED, READ-ONLY ESTABLISHMENT ORDERED BY THE USER'S RULING 26 OF 2026-08-09 HAS RUN (CC, `cc_instruction_return_continuation_4.md` Task 3), AND IT ANSWERS THE QUESTION IN ONE DIRECTION ONLY — SO THIS ROW STAYS OPEN AND WHAT REMAINS IS NAMED.** **The population was DERIVED, never sampled:** the evidence document's own stated method — notated key signature against the published annotated key, read from the corpus metadata — was applied mechanically to every piece in that file rather than its six-row table being transcribed, and it yields a population many times larger than that table shows. **★ WHAT THE COMPARISON CANNOT SEE, measured rather than assumed and stated before any value in it is read:** every committed output directory for this repertoire predates the date the joint estimator became the production inference layer, none carries a corpus manifest, and none carries any field naming an inference arm — **so the committed outputs are the LEGACY arm's, and this comparison cannot answer whether the production arm reads these scores correctly.** That half of the row is untouched and stays open. **★ WHAT IT DOES ESTABLISH IS NOT WHAT WAS EXPECTED, and it is rowed at [[OI-363]]:** the legacy correction — the handling this row's own premise treats as the thing the production arm lacks — **does not resolve the derived population at the committed outputs.** A large minority of the members is NOT read with the annotated tonic; the large majority of the disagreements land on a home of the NOTATED signature, which is the evidence document's own diagnostic for the lock the correction exists to escape; and the shortfall is concentrated in the major-key half of the population. *(★ THE FIRST CLAUSE WAS CORRECTED 2026-08-09 by `cc_instruction_return_continuation_7.md` Task 2. THE FORMER WORDING, PRESERVED (#12): "Fewer than half of the members are read with the annotated tonic." It was INVERTED against the artifact it cites — at the column it names the agreeing members outnumber the disagreeing ones, by a narrow margin. The other two clauses are true and are not disturbed, the finding stands, and the user's Ruling 35(c) is not disturbed: it ruled the FORM of a direction-without-value statement acceptable, and a ruling about form cannot make a direction true. Account at `cowork_away_returns.md` §2.11.)* Every value is at `tools/audit/oi357_partial_signature_establishment.json` and none is restated here (**D-431**). **This changes what the row's remaining question is worth asking about**, and it changes nothing about the analysis: no fix, no design, no inference change, and no measurement of the production arm was taken. **★ THE PRODUCTION-ARM RUN THE USER'S RULING 35(b) LICENSED HAS NOW RUN (CC, `cc_instruction_return_continuation_7.md` Task 2), AND THIS ROW'S FIRST QUESTION IS ANSWERED WHILE THE ROW STAYS OPEN FOR ITS SECOND.** The arm that ships was run over the whole derived population with `--joint-inference`, its effect established at the outputs' own `analysisPath` field rather than trusted from the command line; outputs went to `scratch_artifacts/` and nowhere else, nothing was promoted, no golden or gate moved, and the run record carries the #16 stamps. **ANSWERED: the production arm reads the LARGE MAJORITY of the derived population with the annotated tonic, its disagreements are a small minority, and it carries no partial-signature correction at all** — which is exactly the "NOT claimed" half this row already stated, moved from conjecture to measurement. **★ AND ONE THING HAD TO BE BUILT BEFORE ANY OF IT COULD BE COMPARED:** the production arm's batch output publishes NO top-level whole-run key field, only a key per region, so the comparison this row was waiting for could not have been made on the field it names — run unchanged it would have scored every piece a disagreement and reported a surface artifact as a catastrophe. The two arms share one surface, the per-region key, which is reduced to a whole-run reading by a duration-weighted vote computed identically for both arms, with its faithfulness against the published field measured rather than assumed. **★ A SAME-COMMIT CONTROL WAS ALSO RUN AND IT CHANGES WHAT MAY BE CONCLUDED:** the committed outputs are two months older and used a different preset, so the legacy arm was re-run at this commit under the same preset — the two arms are then CLOSE, with the production arm modestly ahead, and **the large difference is between either HEAD run and the June outputs, which is not attributable to the arm.** That control run is a REPORTED WIDENING of Ruling 35(b)'s letter (**D-654**), with its ground stated at `cowork_away_returns.md`'s Task 2 log. **STILL OPEN: the second half of this row's own question — *by what means* — on which this pass counts and does not explain; and the per-case reading, which it does not make.** Every value is at `tools/audit/oi357_production_arm_comparison.json`, `tools/audit/oi357_legacy_arm_same_commit_control.json` and the two run records, and none is restated here (**D-431**). **Nothing is proposed** — no fix, no design, no inference change. **★ THE USER HAS NOW RULED ON THAT PASS — Ruling 43 of `cowork_rulings_2026_08_09_eighth_stop.md`, recorded here 2026-08-09 by `cc_instruction_return_continuation_8.md` Task 0 — AND THE ROW STAYS OPEN, WHICH IS A READING OF THE ROW'S OWN TERMS AND IS STATED SO IT CAN BE OVERRIDDEN IN ONE ACT.** Three things are ratified. **(i) The same-commit legacy control is ACCEPTED**, on the reported-widening ground (**D-654**), because it replaced a false large-arm-effect conclusion with a controlled one — most of the apparent gap is NOT the arm. **(ii) The inversion corrections applied within the previous session's authority are ratified as CORRECTIONS OF RECORD**, and Ruling 35(c) is undisturbed: it ruled a FORM acceptable and never made a direction true. **(iii) The substantive outcome is recorded: this row's question is ANSWERED — the production arm handles the partial-signature repertoire AT LEAST AS WELL as the legacy arm's explicit correction, established by controlled comparison with both artifacts re-deriving byte-identically.** **WHY THE ROW IS NOT FLIPPED:** the applying dispatch conditions a flip on the question reading answered *in both directions at the row's own terms*, and this row's own terms name TWO owed things — *does the production arm read these scores correctly* (answered) and *by what means* (not answered, and this pass counts rather than explains) — beside the per-case reading it also names and does not make. **So what the ruling answers is recorded and what remains is named, rather than the row being closed over a half it still carries** ([[OI-283]]'s shape). A user who reads the ruling's *ANSWERED* as covering the whole row can flip it in one act; nothing else would move with it. The ruling's own record of its acceptance and its bounds is at the comparison artifacts' closing state, written into their generator so it re-derives (**D-431**). Two uncertainties ride with it: (i) 60 and 10 have no stated derivation; (ii) at n = 60 a true unplaceable rate of 10 % would be observed above 10/60 in about 3 cases in 100, and a true rate of 25 % at or below 10/60 in about 9 cases in 100 (binomial, computed); an exact two-sided 95 % range for an observed 10/60 spans about 8 % to 29 %. the_reach_stated.★_this_is_a_LOWER_BOUND_and_not_a_census: The term list is AUTHORED.  A passage about L0's or L1's subject that uses none of these words is NOT found by this search, and this artifact does not know how many such passages exist.  The hit population is therefore published as a LOWER BOUND on the outgoing text, never as a census (D-673, and the recognizer clause of the dispatch protocol).
the_reach_stated.is_there_an_independently_known_populati: NO.  Nothing other than this search enumerates 'passages of the current text about L0's or L1's subject', so no seed set can establish it and no both-ways reconciliation is available.  Its reach is therefore declared UNMEASURED.
the_reach_stated.what_bounds_the_exposure: The eleven NAMED members are in the population by name regardless of the search, and they are the territory the ruling identified by reading rather than by pattern.  The search widens that territory; it does not define it.
the_reach_stated.what_the_recorded_tier_would_have_added: The RECORDED terms are counted per hit at `per_file`, so the effect of admitting on them is readable from this artifact rather than argued.

the_residue_for_the_mining_map.★_what_this_is: Every file the term search HIT that is NOT a member of the ruled specification document set.  Ruling 33 publishes it rather than dropping it (#12).  It is the territory of the phase's OTHER mechanism for design content in non-specification documents — the mining map named at the phase definition §3.4's inputs — and NOTHING here is dispositioned by this comparison.
the_residue_for_the_mining_map.★_what_is_NOT_claimed: That a residue file holds nothing about L0's or L1's subject.  The cut is by DOCUMENT KIND, not by content: a residue file may hold design content, and the mining map is how it reaches L1.  The risk of the ruled option is stated at the ruling itself — a good idea sitting only in a report reaches L1 through the mining map rather than through this comparison.
the_residue_for_the_mining_map.the_statement_that_applies_to_every_entr: hit, outside the specification document set, not dispositioned by this comparison; reachable by the mining map
the_residue_for_the_mining_map.the_per_file_hit_records_are_kept_whole: A residue file keeps its full record at `the_term_search.per_file` — every admitting hit and every recorded hit, with line numbers — exactly as an in-population file does.  Nothing is dropped.
